title: Operation: Apex Extraction

campaign_parameters.retry_policy: Global cap of MAX 2 RETRIES TOTAL across the entire campaign. Failing M1 or M4 adds +1 Doom; failing M2 or M3 adds +2 Doom and triggers the Target B Assistant contingency.
campaign_parameters.side_mission_policy: Pre-Mission 2: Freely allowed. On M2/M3 Failure: 1 Side-Mission allowed before retrying for Target B (Dr. Kaelen). Post-Mission 3 Success: Side-Missions permanently LOCKED prior to Mission 4.
campaign_parameters.side_mission_failure_penalty: Local squad HP/dice/resource blowback; does not consume Campaign Retries.
campaign_parameters.continuous_drop_link: Mission 2 (Part A) -> Mission 3 (Part B) [Continuous Drop / No HQ]

rules_text: Hard 4-Mission Campaign Dossier. Max Doom Threshold: [4 DOOM]. Global Retry Budget: Max 2 Retries Total. Missions 2 & 3 form a linked [Continuous Drop] / [No HQ] operation ([+2 DOOM] on failure, pivoting to Target B Dr. Kaelen with a 1 Side-Mission recovery window). Upon clearing Mission 3, all Side-Missions are permanently locked out prior to Mission 4.

art_spec.visual_description: A high-stakes tactical command dossier showing a satellite thermal feed of a heavily fortified mountain bioweapons complex, an armored convoy racing along a collapsing cliffside highway under gunship fire, and biometric mugshots of VIP targets Dr. Elena Vance and Dr. Kaelen stamped 'PRIORITY EXTRACTION'.
art_spec.art_style: Near-future gritty corporate sci-fi concept art, hard-surface industrial design, matte digital illustration with dramatic rim lighting.

body:
# Campaign Dossier: Operation: Apex Extraction > **Difficulty Rating:** Medium / Hard Complex Campaign (`Tier 3`) > **Operational Scope:** 4 Dense Campaign Missions (3–4 Stages Each; 13 Total Stages) > **Special Rules:** Global Retry Cap (`Max 2`), Linked Double-Mission ([Continuous Drop] / [No HQ]), Target B Pivot, and Finale Side-Mission Lockout --- ## 1. Executive Narrative Brief **Ascendant Bio-Tech** has abducted **Dr. Elena Vance**, chief architect of the *Apex Chimera* bioweapon protocol, holding her inside a heavily fortified subterranean black-site. Your strike team must execute a high-risk four-phase campaign: 1. **Mission 1 — Signal Reconnaissance ([Planet] / [Facility]):** Assault a remote border communications array to decrypt prisoner transport telemetry and pinpoint Dr. Vance's black-site holding cell. 2. **Mission 2 — Black-Site Infiltration ([Facility] / [Covert] — Double-Mission Part A):** Breach Ascendant Research Complex Alpha and extract the VIP from the Bio-Vault Cellblock. **Upon success, skip HQ Downtime entirely and deploy directly into Mission 3!** 3. **Mission 3 — VIP Exfiltration Escort ([Planet] / [Urban] — Double-Mission Part B [Continuous Drop]):** With surviving HP, unspent static dice, and remaining consumables from Mission 2, hijack an armored convoy, survive a mountain pass ambush, and hold the rooftop helipad until extraction arrives. 4. **Mission 4 — Bioweapon Facility Decapitation ([Facility] — Campaign Climax):** With all Side-Missions locked out, use the VIP's biometric overrides to storm Ascendant's Prime Core Laboratory, overload the reactor, purge the Executive Guard, and escape the meltdown. --- ## 2. Campaign Parameters & Lever Configuration | Parameter | Rule Specification | | :--- | :--- | | **Difficulty Rating** | **Medium / Hard Complex Campaign** | | **Sequence Length** | **4 Campaign Missions** (3 Stages in M1–M3; 4 Stages in M4) | | **Max Doom Threshold** | **[4 DOOM] Points** (Immediate Agency Collapse / Game Over at [4 DOOM]) | | **Global Retry Budget** | **MAX 2 RETRIES TOTAL** across the entire campaign | | **The Double-Mission Arc** | **Missions 2 & 3** form a linked 2-Part [Continuous Drop] / [No HQ] Operation | | **Side-Mission Lockout Policy** | • **Pre-Mission 2:** Side-Missions freely allowed.
• **Fail Mission 2 or 3:** `1 Side-Mission ALLOWED` before retrying for the Assistant (*Dr. Kaelen*).
• **Post-Mission 3 Success:** Side-Missions **LOCKED OUT COMPLETELY** (No side-ops between M3 and M4). | | **Allowed Side-Mission Themes** | [Urban], [Facility], [Covert], [Planet] | --- ## 3. body:
# Campaign Dossier: Operation: Iron Dawn

> **Difficulty Rating:** Easy / Standard Initializer (`Tier 1`)  
> **Operational Scope:** 3 Distinct Global & Orbital Deployments (8 Total Stages)  
> **Primary Antagonist:** Ascendant Bio-Tech Research Directorate

---

## 1. Executive Narrative Brief

**Ascendant Bio-Tech** has gone rogue, smuggling illegal cyber-warfare encryption drives and prohibited genetic weapon blueprints through an international shadow network. Your Joint Agency Strike Team is tasked with a three-stage global dismantling operation:

1. **Mission 1 — Black-Market Intercept ([Urban] / [Facility]):** Drop into the Neon Syndicate District (or the mountain perimeter checkpoint in the *Perimeter Breach* variant) to intercept the encryption broker and secure the master decryption keys.
2. **Mission 2 — Deep-Sea Laboratory Raid ([Facility]):** Use the decrypted coordinates to dive into the Pacific Trench Facility, breach heavy automated defenses, and siphon prototype genetic telemetry from the sub-level mainframe.
3. **Mission 3 — Orbital Array Sabotage ([Space]):** Launch a final shuttle assault against Ascendant's high-orbit communications spire, overload the relay power grid, hold the extraction bay under siege, and sever their global command network forever.

---

## 2. Campaign Parameters & Lever Configuration

| Parameter | Rule Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Difficulty Rating** | **Easy / Standard Initializer** |
| **Sequence Length** | **3 Fixed Linear Campaign Missions** |
| **Max Doom Threshold** | **[3 DOOM] Points** (Immediate Agency Collapse / Game Over at [3 DOOM]) |
| **Side-Mission Policy** | **UNLIMITED** access during HQ Downtime between Campaign Missions |
| **Side-Mission Failure Penalty** | **[0 DOOM] Points** (Local tactical HP damage, static die loss, or resource drain only) |
| **Campaign Mission Retry Policy** | **Freely Retriable** upon failure ([+1 DOOM] per failed Campaign Mission) |
| **Allowed Side-Mission Themes** | [Urban], [Facility], [Space], [Covert], [Planet] |

---

## 3. Macro-Spacing & Coherent Retry Logic

* **Macro-Spacing Across Time & Space:** Each mission in *Operation: Iron Dawn* represents a major strategic deployment separated by days or weeks of intelligence processing, Infirmary trauma recovery, and Quartermaster re-arming at HQ.
* **Tactical Retreat & Second Assault Wave:** If the squad fails a Campaign Mission climax stage or declares an emergency retreat, the narrative records that the strike team pulled back before securing the objective. The campaign track advances by **[+1 DOOM]**, and the squad returns to HQ. Retrying the mission represents launching a **Second Assault Wave** against an alerted target or secondary safehouse.

---

## 4. Campaign Mission Sequence

### Mission 1: [Black-Market Intercept / Perimeter Breach](../missions/mission-iron-dawn-1-black-market-intercept.md)
* **Stages:** 2 Stages (`Syndicate Alleyway / Outer Checkpoint` $\rightarrow$ `Broker's Safe-Vault / Lift Terminal Control`)
* **Base Clearance Bounty:** [6 CR], [1 PIP]
* **Squad Requirement:** $\ge 1$ [Combat] operative

### Mission 2: [Deep-Sea Laboratory Raid / The Subterranean Core](../missions/mission-iron-dawn-2-deep-sea-laboratory-raid.md)
* **Stages:** 3 Stages (`Ocean Platform Docks / Containment Patrol` $\rightarrow$ `Heavy Enforcer Gate` $\rightarrow$ `Sub-Level Mainframe / Bio-Lab Mainframe`)
* **Base Clearance Bounty:** [8 CR], [2 PIP]
* **Squad Requirement:** $\ge 1$ [Combat], $\ge 1$ [Intel] operative

### Mission 3: [Orbital Array Sabotage / Extraction Zero](../missions/mission-iron-dawn-3-orbital-array-sabotage.md)
* **Stages:** 3 Stages (`Hangar Bay Breach / Overload Terminal` $\rightarrow$ `Relay Power Grid / Helipad Defense` $\rightarrow$ `Master Control Hub / Evacuation Dash`)
* **Base Clearance Bounty:** **CAMPAIGN VICTORY!** (Proceed to Final Executive [VP] Audit)
* **Squad Requirement:** $\ge 2$ [Combat], $\ge 1$ [Survival] operative

---

## 5. Balance & Focus Pyramid Audit

| Metric | Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Total Stages Across Campaign** | `8 Stages` (2 + 3 + 3) |
| **Base [Combat] Stages** | `5 of 8 Stages` (`62.5% [Combat]` — Exceeds the 50% Focus Pyramid Mandate) |
| **Frontline Mandate** | Every mission includes at least 1 [Combat] stage |
| **Dynamic Focus Swaps** | Available on `6 of 8 Stages` (*Force Breach* or *Tactical Bypass*) |
| **Doom Escalation** | Stage failures inflict local HP/dice/credit blowback; Mission failures add [+1 DOOM] (`3 Max`) |

# Agent 24: Rhea "Rig" Kovacs (*The EOD Drone Operator*)

* **Class:** Technician (`Zero-Combat Specialist`)
* **Focus Profile:** Primary: [Operations] (`3+`) | Secondary: [Infiltrate] (`4+`) | Out of Focus: `5+`
* **Base Stats:** **`3 HP`** (`4.5 ES`) • **`7 Static Dice`** (`3.5 ES`) • **Power:** `1.0 ES` • **Class Offset:** `0.0 ES` (**Total:** `9.0 ES`)

---

## Class Ability: Adaptive Calibration ([1 EF])

Activate after rolling dice to **convert any 1 rolled miss into a guaranteed success**, OR activate before rolling to **reduce the [EF] activation cost of an equipped [Complex] item by [-1 EF]** (to a minimum of `0`).

---

## Unique Power: Drone Telemetry (`1.0 ES` — Tier 2 Passive)

Whenever Rhea activates an equipped **[Complex]** item, its activation cost is reduced by **[-1 EF]** (minimum `0`) and it grants **`+1 additional temporary static die`** on top of its printed effect.

body:
# The Infirmary (Medical Wing)

* **Baseline Capability:** **2 Treatment Beds**. Each bed provides **3 Healing Dice** to a resting non-deployed operative during Step 3 of HQ Downtime.
* **Healing Resolution:** Every die showing **`5+`** heals `1 missing HP`. Rolling a **natural `1`** calcifies that point of damage into a **Permanent Trauma Token** (`-1 Max HP`, `-1 Starting Static Die`). Any damage remaining unhealed at the end of Step 3 converts into a **Critical Injury Token**.

---

## Sponsorable Modules

Sponsoring any module awards **[+1 PIP]** ([2 VP]) to the funding Faction and places their Faction Token on the module.

| Module Name | Sponsorship Cost | Reward | Agency-Wide Passive Effect |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Surgical Wing** | [4 CR] | [+1 PIP] | Adds **+2 additional Treatment Beds** (4 total beds baseline; 6 during a Stand-Down round). |
| **Trauma Cybernetics** | [4 CR] | [+1 PIP] | Upgrades medical lasers: all Healing Dice clear damage on a **`4+`** (and Critical Injury healing improves from `6+` to **`5+`**). |
| **Gene-Stasis Tank** | `[1 PIP] + [3 CR]` | [+1 PIP] | Spending **[1 EF]** from a Faction Vault during Downtime automatically restores `1 missing HP` without rolling dice (zero risk of natural `1` Permanent Trauma). |

# Cryo-Stasis Chamber (Standalone Landmark)

* **Sponsorship Cost:** `[2 PIP] + [6 CR]`
* **Sponsorship Reward:** **[+2 PIP]** ([4 VP]) + Faction Token placement
* **Control Mode:** **Sponsor-Controlled** (`Capacity: 1 Operative`)

---

## Landmark Effect

During **Step 3 (Healing & Medical Recovery)** of HQ Downtime, the chamber holds **1 wounded operative** and **automatically restores 100% of their missing Hit Points** without rolling any Healing Dice (completely eliminating the risk of rolling a natural `1` Permanent Trauma).

Because this Landmark is **Sponsor-Controlled**, the Sponsor Faction decides which operative occupies the pod each round—and may openly auction or rent the slot to desperate rival Factions for [CR] or items.

# Automated Suppressive Turret

> *"Drop the tripod, lock the IFF transponder to squad frequencies, and let the rotary servos hold the hallway."*

## Overview

The **Automated Suppressive Turret** is a Tier 1 [Complex] deployable fire-support platform priced at [3 CR]. Set up during Step 1 (Briefing) of any [Combat] or [Survival] stage, it provides +2 temporary static dice to the squad pool—and can be deliberately red-lined into a single-use **Overclock** burst that lowers the entire squad's hit threshold to `4+` before burning out its barrel assembly.

---

## Equipment Specifications

* **Slots Required:** [Complex] (1 Slot)
* **Market Cost:** [3 CR] *(1.5 ES Value)*
* **Type:** Deployable Fire Support

---

## Tactical Capabilities

### Deployment *(Step 1 Briefing)*
Deploy during Step 1 (Briefing) of a [Combat] or [Survival] stage. Grants **+2 temporary static dice** to the squad's pool for that stage.

### Active Cost: Overclock *(Spend Die & Sacrifice)*
Spend **1 static die** from your pool before rolling to force the turret to target heavy units, allowing all squad dice to succeed on a **4+** for that check. The turret burns out and is **discarded** after the stage.

* **Market Cost:** [3 CR] *(1.5 ES Value)*

### Active Cost: Resource Siphon *(Spend Die on Momentum Clear)*
Whenever your squad clears an [Intel] or [Operations] stage with **Operational Momentum [MOM] (+2 or higher)**, spend **1 static die** to instantly extract **[+2 CR]** directly into your Faction Vault.

# Neural Tactical AI ("Valkyrie Drone")

> *"Linked directly to the operative's optic nerve, Valkyrie calculates ricochet vectors in real time—and carries enough reserve capacitor charge to jump-start an entire squad's rigs."*

## Overview

The **Neural Tactical AI ("Valkyrie Drone")** is an elite Tier 2 autonomous AI companion occupying the [Complex] slot at [9 CR]. Providing constant predictive targeting that grants a free failure-face re-roll on every single stage check, Valkyrie also stores an emergency capacitor reserve that lets its owner trigger a full squad-wide +2 static dice refresh for just [1 EF] (a 2-Effort discount over standard *Logistical Refresh*).

---

## Equipment Specifications

* **Slots Required:** [Complex] (1 Slot)
* **Market Cost:** [9 CR] *(4.5 ES Value)*
* **Type:** Autonomous AI Companion

---

> *"Magnetic clamps and hydraulic anchors that lock directly into facility sub-flooring, absorbing catastrophic kinetic shockwaves when an operation collapses."*

## Overview

The **Stasis Anchor Greaves** allow an operative to spend [1 EF] from their Faction Vault whenever a stage check fails to completely shield both themselves and an adjacent ally from all stage failure HP penalties.

## Equipment Profile

* **Slot Requirement:** [Legs]
* **Quartermaster Cost:** [7 CR] *(3.5 ES Value)*
* **Deck Quantity:** 1 Copy
* **Equipment Type:** Tier 2 Exclusive (Shock Absorber)

## Core Mechanics

* **Shock Absorber:** If a stage check fails, you may spend **[1 EF]** from your Faction Vault. If you do, completely negate all stage failure HP damage that would be suffered by this character and **1 adjacent ally**.

# Mission 1: Signal Reconnaissance

> **Campaign:** [Operation: Apex Extraction](../campaigns/campaign-apex-extraction.md) (`Mission 1 of 4`)  
> **Location:** Border Communications Array ([Planet] / [Facility] Standard Drop)  
> **Base Clearance Bounty:** [6 CR], [1 PIP]  
> **Side-Mission Window:** Unlocked and freely available upon return to HQ

---

## 1. Narrative Briefing

**Ascendant Bio-Tech** has captured **Dr. Elena Vance**, chief bioweapons architect, and is routing her prisoner transport coordinates through a remote mountain communications relay post. The strike team drops onto the windswept ridge to breach the perimeter checkpoint, clear or bypass the fortified patrol bunker, and decrypt the relay server vault to pinpoint her black-site holding cell.

* **Return to HQ:** Upon clearing Stage 3, the squad extracts to HQ to process the telemetry and prepare for the **Double-Mission Continuous Drop (Missions 2 & 3)**. Side-Missions are freely unlocked prior to launching Mission 2.
* **Failure & Retry Rules:** Failing Mission 1 advances the Campaign Doom Track by **[+1 DOOM]** and consumes **`1 Campaign Retry`** from the campaign's strict **2-retry global budget**.

---

## 2. Preset Stage Track (3 Stages)

| Stage | Stage Name | Preset Focus | Target Difficulty ($D$) | Dynamic Focus Swap Option | Stage Failure Penalty |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Outer Gate Checkpoint** | [Combat] | **3 Successes** | **Tactical Bypass ([Infiltrate]):** Target $D = 4$ | Alarm triggered! All deployed operatives lose **1 static die**; Stage 2 $D$ increases by **$+1$ Success**. |
| **2** | **Patrol Bunker** | [Combat] | **4 Successes** *(5 if S1 failed)* | **Tactical Bypass ([Survival]):** Cost [1 EF], Target $D = 4$ | Suppressive fire! All deployed operatives take **1 HP damage**; Stage 3 $D$ increases by **$+1$ Success**. |
| **3** | **Relay Server Vault** | [Intel] | **4 Successes** *(+1 if S2 failed)* | **Force Breach ([Combat]):** Target $D = 6$ | **Mission Failure:** Add **[+1 DOOM]** and consume **1 Campaign Retry** (of 2 max). |

---

## 3. Detailed Stage Breakdown

### Stage 1: Outer Gate Checkpoint
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 3 Successes**
  * *Narrative:* Eliminating Ascendant perimeter sentries at the mountain access gate before they can alert the bunker garrison.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Tactical Bypass ([Infiltrate]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Infiltrate] at **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**.
  * *Narrative:* Scale the icy perimeter cliffside and cut through laser sensor fencing unseen.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Perimeter alarm triggered! Every deployed operative loses **1 static die** from shock, and Stage 2 Target Difficulty escalates by **`+1 Success`**.

---

### Stage 2: Patrol Bunker
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes** *(Escalates to **5 Successes** if Stage 1 failed)*
  * *Narrative:* Clearing a reinforced concrete guard bunker blocking the subterranean conduit to the relay vault.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Tactical Bypass ([Survival]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may spend **[1 EF]** from their Faction Vault to shift the stage to [Survival] at **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes** *(or **5 Successes** if Stage 1 failed)*.
  * *Narrative:* Detour around the fortified bunker by crawling through sub-zero mountain drainage tunnels.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Heavy interlocking gunfire! Every deployed operative takes **1 point of HP damage**, and Stage 3 Target Difficulty escalates by **`+1 Success`**.

---

### Stage 3: Relay Server Vault (Climax Stage)
* **Preset Focus:** [Intel] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes** *(Escalates to **5 Successes** if Stage 2 failed)*
  * *Narrative:* Overriding server ICE terminals and decrypting prisoner transport telemetry confirming Dr. Vance's location at Complex Alpha.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Force Breach ([Combat]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Combat] at **Target Difficulty: 6 Successes** *(or **7 Successes** if Stage 2 failed)*.
  * *Narrative:* Blast open the encrypted server racks and physically rip out the master telemetry drives under heavy security fire.
* **Stage Clearance:**
  * **Mission Accomplished!** Award **[6 CR]** and **[1 PIP]**. The squad returns to HQ with Side-Missions unlocked before launching Mission 2.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Mission Failure):**
  * Telemetry is wiped before decryption completes! Advance the Campaign Doom Track by **[+1 DOOM]** and consume **`1 Campaign Retry`** from the global 2-retry budget.

# Mission 2: Black-Site Infiltration (Double-Mission: Part A)

> **Campaign:** [Operation: Apex Extraction](../campaigns/campaign-apex-extraction.md) (`Mission 2 of 4 — Double-Mission Part A`)  
> **Location:** Ascendant Research Complex Alpha ([Facility] / [Covert] VIP Abduction)  
> **Special Deployment Rule:** **[Continuous Drop] Link to Mission 3** (Skip HQ Downtime on Clearance!)  
> **Failure Penalty:** **[+2 DOOM]** + Consumes `1 Campaign Retry` + Pivots to **Target B (Dr. Kaelen)**

---

## 1. Narrative Briefing & Special Rules

The strike team infiltrates **Ascendant Research Complex Alpha** to breach outer security defenses, fight through the sub-level garrison barracks, and override the high-security bio-locks sealing **Dr. Elena Vance** inside the Bio-Vault Cellblock.

### Continuous Link Rule (`Part A` $\rightarrow$ `Part B [No HQ]`)
* If Mission 2 succeeds, **skip HQ Downtime completely!**
* The squad **does not return to HQ**—they immediately transition into **[Mission 3: VIP Exfiltration Escort](./mission-apex-extraction-3-vip-exfiltration-escort.md)** carrying only their surviving HP, remaining unspent static dice, equipped gear, and unspent Consumables.

### Failure & Retry Contingency (Target B Pivot)
* If Mission 2 fails, **Dr. Elena Vance** is executed or evacuated off-world by Ascendant forces.
* **Failure Penalty:** Advance the Campaign Doom Track by **[+2 DOOM]** and consume **`1 Campaign Retry`** from the global 2-retry budget.
* **Side-Mission Recovery Window:** Upon retreating to HQ, the squad is granted **1 optional Side-Mission opportunity** to farm gear/credits and heal in the Infirmary before retrying Mission 2.
* **The Narrative Retry Pivot:** Retrying Mission 2 forces the squad to launch a secondary assault on **Facility Beta** to capture Dr. Vance's lead assistant, **Dr. Kaelen**, under heightened guard parameters.

---

## 2. Preset Stage Track (3 Stages)

| Stage | Stage Name | Preset Focus | Target Difficulty ($D$) | Dynamic Focus Swap Option | Stage Failure Penalty |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Perimeter Guard Gate** | [Combat] | **4 Successes** | **Tactical Bypass ([Infiltrate]):** Target $D = 4$ | Lockdown initiated! All deployed operatives lose **1 static die**; Stage 2 $D$ increases by **$+1$ Success**. |
| **2** | **Sub-Level Barracks** | [Combat] | **3 Successes** *(4 if S1 failed)* | *(None — Mandatory Kinetic Fight)* | Close-quarters crossfire! All deployed operatives take **1 HP damage**; Stage 3 $D$ increases by **$+1$ Success**. |
| **3** | **Bio-Vault Cellblock** | [Operations] | **4 Successes** *(+1 if S2 failed)* | **Force Breach ([Combat]):** Target $D = 5$ | **Mission Failure:** Add **[+2 DOOM]**, consume **1 Retry**, allow `1 Side-Mission`, pivot to **Dr. Kaelen**. |

---

## 3. Detailed Stage Breakdown

### Stage 1: Perimeter Guard Gate
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**
  * *Narrative:* Assaulting the heavily armed outer security gate of Ascendant Complex Alpha (or Facility Beta on a Target B retry).
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Tactical Bypass ([Infiltrate]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Infiltrate] at **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**.
  * *Narrative:* Spoof biometric gate transponders and slip past the outer black-site checkpoint undetected.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Black-site lockdown initiated! Every deployed operative loses **1 static die** from shock, and Stage 2 Target Difficulty escalates by **`+1 Success`**.

---

### Stage 2: Sub-Level Barracks (Mandatory Fight)
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 3 Successes** *(Escalates to **4 Successes** if Stage 1 failed)*
  * *Narrative:* A point-blank firefight through the rapid-response security barracks blocking the elevator to the holding cells.
* **No Dynamic Swap Available:** Mandatory kinetic bottleneck.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Close-quarters crossfire! Every deployed operative takes **1 point of HP damage**, and Stage 3 Target Difficulty escalates by **`+1 Success`**.

---

### Stage 3: Bio-Vault Cellblock (Part A Climax Stage)
* **Preset Focus:** [Operations] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes** *(Escalates to **5 Successes** if Stage 2 failed)*
  * *Narrative:* Overriding the triple-redundant biometric containment locks to extract VIP Dr. Elena Vance (or Dr. Kaelen) from her holding cell.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Force Breach ([Combat]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Combat] at **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes** *(or **6 Successes** if Stage 2 failed)*.
  * *Narrative:* Detonate shaped breaching charges on the containment cell doors and gun down the warden's guard detail.
* **Stage Clearance ([Continuous Drop] Trigger):**
  * **VIP Secured!** Award **[8 CR]** and **[2 PIP]** to Faction Vaults (logged for HQ). **Do NOT return to HQ**—proceed immediately to Stage 1 of **[Mission 3: VIP Exfiltration Escort](./mission-apex-extraction-3-vip-exfiltration-escort.md)** with current HP, unspent static dice, and remaining consumables!
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Mission Failure):**
  * VIP Dr. Vance is lost! Add **[+2 DOOM]** and consume **`1 Campaign Retry`**. Return to HQ (with **1 optional Side-Mission** allowed) before retrying Mission 2 at Facility Beta for **Dr. Kaelen**.

# Mission 3: VIP Exfiltration Escort (Double-Mission: Part B)

> **Campaign:** [Operation: Apex Extraction](../campaigns/campaign-apex-extraction.md) (`Mission 3 of 4 — Double-Mission Part B`)  
> **Location:** Industrial Highway / Mountain Pass ([Continuous Drop] / [No HQ] from Mission 2)  
> **Base Clearance Bounty:** [10 CR], [2 PIP]  
> **Post-Clearance Lockout:** Upon clearing Stage 3, **all Side-Missions lock out permanently** prior to Mission 4!

---

## 1. Narrative Briefing & Special Rules

Carrying the extracted VIP (**Dr. Elena Vance** or **Dr. Kaelen**), the exhausted strike team bursts out of the subterranean black-site onto an industrial mountain highway. With Ascendant kill-squads and VTOL gunships closing in, the squad must hijack an armored transport, survive a perilous run across crumbling mountain pass catwalks, and defend the elevated helipad until the Agency extraction shuttle touches down.

### [Continuous Drop] / [No HQ] Entry Rule
* The squad enters Stage 1 of Mission 3 **directly from Mission 2 without an HQ Downtime Phase**.
* Operatives retain only the HP, unspent static dice, Armor Buffers (which refresh per stage as normal if intact), and remaining Consumables that survived Mission 2.
* The Squad Leader may still use **Logistical Refresh** ([2 EF] = $+1$ static die to all; [3 EF] = $+2$ static dice to all) during Step 1 (Briefing) of any stage to replenish the exhausted squad's dice pools!

### Post-Mission 3 Side-Mission Lockout Rule
* Upon successfully clearing Stage 3, the squad returns to HQ for one final Downtime Phase (healing, shopping, and Command Auction), but **all Side-Missions are permanently locked out**. The squad must proceed straight into **Mission 4 (Bioweapon Facility Decapitation)**.

### Failure & Retry Contingency
* If Mission 3 fails, the VIP is recaptured or killed during the siege.
* **Failure Penalty:** Advance the Campaign Doom Track by **[+2 DOOM]** and consume **`1 Campaign Retry`** from the global 2-retry budget.
* **Recovery Window:** If [DOOM] is below 4 and a retry remains, the squad returns to HQ and may execute **1 optional Side-Mission** before retrying the linked Mission 2/3 arc for the secondary target (**Dr. Kaelen**).

---

## 2. Preset Stage Track (3 Stages)

| Stage | Stage Name | Preset Focus | Target Difficulty ($D$) | Dynamic Focus Swap Option | Stage Failure Penalty |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Convoy Ambush** | [Combat] | **4 Successes** | **Tactical Bypass ([Survival]):** Cost [1 EF], Target $D = 4$ | RPG strike! All deployed operatives take **1 HP damage**; Stage 2 $D$ increases by **$+1$ Success**. |
| **2** | **Mountain Pass Run** | [Survival] | **4 Successes** *(5 if S1 failed)* | **Force Breach ([Combat]):** Target $D = 5$ | Collapsing catwalk! All deployed operatives lose **1 static die**; Stage 3 $D$ increases by **$+1$ Success**. |
| **3** | **Helipad Evac Siege** | [Combat] | **5 Successes** *(+1 if S2 failed)* | *(None — Mandatory Siege Firefight)* | **Mission Failure:** VIP recaptured! Add **[+2 DOOM]**, consume **1 Retry**, allow `1 Side-Mission`. |

---

## 3. Detailed Stage Breakdown

### Stage 1: Convoy Ambush
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**
  * *Narrative:* Fighting through an Ascendant armored roadblock ambushing the hijacked transport convoy on the industrial highway.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Tactical Bypass ([Survival]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may spend **[1 EF]** from their Faction Vault to shift the stage to [Survival] at **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**.
  * *Narrative:* Ram the armored transport through the roadblock barrier and veer onto a treacherous off-road industrial service trail.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Armor-piercing RPG strike! Every deployed operative takes **1 point of HP damage**, and Stage 2 Target Difficulty escalates by **`+1 Success`**.

---

### Stage 2: Mountain Pass Run
* **Preset Focus:** [Survival] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes** *(Escalates to **5 Successes** if Stage 1 failed)*
  * *Narrative:* Escorting the VIP on foot across crumbling, ice-slicked cliffside catwalks after the transport is disabled.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Force Breach ([Combat]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Combat] at **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes** *(or **6 Successes** if Stage 1 failed)*.
  * *Narrative:* Stand your ground on the exposed bridge span and engage the pursuing Ascendant VTOL gunships with heavy weapons.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Collapsing catwalk debris! Every deployed operative loses **1 static die** from exhaustion, and Stage 3 Target Difficulty escalates by **`+1 Success`**.

---

### Stage 3: Helipad Evac Siege (Part B Climax Stage)
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes** *(Escalates to **6 Successes** if Stage 2 failed)*
  * *Narrative:* Holding the rooftop extraction helipad against a desperate final wave of Ascendant shock troops while the VIP boards the shuttle.
* **No Dynamic Swap Available:** Mandatory siege firefight.
* **Stage Clearance:**
  * **VIP Extracted!** Award **[10 CR]** and **[2 PIP]**. Return to HQ for final Downtime preparation. **All Side-Missions are now permanently LOCKED OUT** prior to Mission 4.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Mission Failure):**
  * The VIP is recaptured by enemy forces! Add **[+2 DOOM]** and consume **`1 Campaign Retry`**. If eligible to continue, the squad may run **1 optional Side-Mission** before retrying Mission 2/3 for **Dr. Kaelen**.

# Mission 4: Bioweapon Facility Decapitation (Campaign Climax)

> **Campaign:** [Operation: Apex Extraction](../campaigns/campaign-apex-extraction.md) (`Mission 4 of 4 — Campaign Finale`)  
> **Location:** Ascendant Prime Core Laboratory ([Facility] Final Stand)  
> **Pre-Mission Lockdown:** Side-Missions are strictly prohibited prior to launching Mission 4  
> **Base Clearance Bounty:** **CAMPAIGN VICTORY!** (Triggers Final Executive [VP] Audit)

---

## 1. Narrative Briefing

With the VIP (**Dr. Elena Vance** or **Dr. Kaelen**) in Agency custody and Side-Missions locked out, the strike team launches an all-out decapitation strike against **Ascendant's Prime Core Laboratory**. Armed with the VIP's master biometric overrides, the squad must storm the fortified outer ramparts, trigger an irreversible overload in the subterranean reactor core, annihilate Ascendant's elite Executive Guard, and escape the collapsing mountain complex before total meltdown.

---

## 2. Preset Stage Track (4 Stages — Campaign Climax)

| Stage | Stage Name | Preset Focus | Target Difficulty ($D$) | Dynamic Focus Swap Option | Stage Failure Penalty |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Outer Rampart Siege** | [Combat] | **4 Successes** | **Tactical Bypass ([Infiltrate]):** Target $D = 4$ | Artillery barrage! All deployed operatives take **1 HP damage**; Stage 2 $D$ increases by **$+1$ Success**. |
| **2** | **Reactor Core Overload** | [Operations] | **5 Successes** *(6 if S1 failed)* | **Force Breach ([Combat]):** Target $D = 6$ | Radiation surge! All deployed operatives take **1 HP damage** and lose **1 static die**. |
| **3** | **Executive Guard Core** | [Combat] | **5 Successes** | *(None — Mandatory Elite Fight)* | Elite counter-strike! All operatives take **1 HP damage**, Squad Leader loses **[1 EF]**, Stage 4 $D$ **$+1$**. |
| **4** | **Meltdown Evacuation** | [Survival] | **5 Successes** *(6 if S3 failed)* | **Tactical Bypass ([Operations]):** Cost [1 EF], Target $D = 5$ | **Mission Failure:** Add **[+1 DOOM]** and consume **1 Campaign Retry** (if budget remains). |

---

## 3. Detailed Stage Breakdown

### Stage 1: Outer Rampart Siege
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**
  * *Narrative:* Breaching the heavily fortified outer bunker ramparts of Ascendant's Prime Core Laboratory.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Tactical Bypass ([Infiltrate]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Infiltrate] at **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**.
  * *Narrative:* Use the extracted VIP's biometric clearance codes to slip through the subterranean waste-disposal airlocks unseen.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Rampart artillery barrage! Every deployed operative takes **1 point of HP damage**, and Stage 2 Target Difficulty escalates by **`+1 Success`**.

---

### Stage 2: Reactor Core Overload
* **Preset Focus:** [Operations] — **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes** *(Escalates to **6 Successes** if Stage 1 failed)*
  * *Narrative:* Overriding the subterranean fusion reactor safety interlocks to initiate a facility-wide thermal sterilization purge of the *Apex Chimera* bioweapon vats.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Force Breach ([Combat]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Combat] at **Target Difficulty: 6 Successes** *(or **7 Successes** if Stage 1 failed)*.
  * *Narrative:* Detonate high-explosive demolition charges directly against the primary reactor coolant manifolds while fighting off armed core technicians.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Plasma radiation surge! Every deployed operative takes **1 point of HP damage** and loses **1 static die** from their pool.

---

### Stage 3: Executive Guard Core (Mandatory Fight)
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes**
  * *Narrative:* A brutal firefight against Ascendant's cybernetically enhanced Executive Directorate Guard blocking the evacuation shaft.
* **No Dynamic Swap Available:** Mandatory kinetic bottleneck.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Elite Directorate counter-strike! Every deployed operative takes **1 point of HP damage**, the Squad Leader loses **[1 EF]** from their Faction Vault, and Stage 4 Target Difficulty escalates by **`+1 Success`**.

---

### Stage 4: Meltdown Evacuation (Campaign Finale)
* **Preset Focus:** [Survival] — **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes** *(Escalates to **6 Successes** if Stage 3 failed)*
  * *Narrative:* Sprinting through collapsing subterranean tunnels and toxic chemical fires to reach the surface extraction point before the reactor detonates.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Tactical Bypass ([Operations]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may spend **[1 EF]** from their Faction Vault to shift the stage to [Operations] at **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes** *(or **6 Successes** if Stage 3 failed)*.
  * *Narrative:* Hotwire the executive high-speed rail-pod launchers to blast out of the collapsing mountain complex.
* **Stage Clearance (Campaign Victory!):**
  * **CAMPAIGN VICTORY!** The *Apex Chimera* bioweapon facility is obliterated and the strike team survives. Proceed immediately to the **Final Executive [VP] Audit**: convert [PIP] (`[2 VP]`), living & Dead Pool [LOY] (`[2 VP]` + `[3 VP]` per Tier 4 Icon), and score Tiered **Secret Objectives** (`15 / 10 / [5 VP]`).
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Mission Failure):**
  * Catastrophic tunnel collapse forces an emergency abort! Advance the Campaign Doom Track by **[+1 DOOM]** and consume **`1 Campaign Retry`**. If [DOOM] hits `4` or the squad has exceeded its `2-Retry Global Cap`, the campaign ends in **Game Over (Agency Collapse)**.

# Mission 1: Black-Market Intercept / Perimeter Breach

> **Campaign:** [Operation: Iron Dawn](../campaigns/campaign-iron-dawn.md) (`Mission 1 of 3`)  
> **Location:** Neon Syndicate District ([Urban] Macro-Arc) / Mountain Perimeter Outpost ([Facility] Variant)  
> **Base Clearance Bounty:** [6 CR], [1 PIP]  
> **Squad Target Requirement:** $\ge 1$ [Combat] operative

---

## 1. Narrative Briefing & Theater Variants

This mission card supports both canonical theater variants from the *Operation: Iron Dawn* design specification:

* **Revised Global Macro-Arc ("Black-Market Intercept" — Neon Syndicate District):** Ascendant Bio-Tech is smuggling experimental cyber-warfare encryption drives through an underground black market. The squad deploys to an urban nightlife district to neutralize syndicate lookouts, breach the broker's secure vault, and steal the master decryption keys needed to locate Ascendant's deep-sea laboratory.
* **Facility Incursion Variant ("Perimeter Breach" — Mountain Outpost):** The squad drops into the snow-covered mountains surrounding an unauthorized Ascendant Bio-Tech research facility to neutralize the outer watchtower checkpoint and hijack the subterranean lift terminal.
* **Return to HQ:** Upon clearing Stage 2, the squad extracts to HQ to decipher the stolen telemetry and outfit for Mission 2.
* **Retry Narrative:** If Stage 2 fails, internal lockdown seals the target and the squad executes a **Tactical Retreat** ([+1 DOOM]). Retrying Mission 1 launches a **Second Assault Wave** against the broker's secondary safehouse (or alerted perimeter gate).

---

## 2. Preset Stage Track (2 Stages)

| Stage | Stage Name | Preset Focus | Target Difficulty ($D$) | Dynamic Focus Swap Option | Stage Failure Penalty |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Syndicate Alleyway** *(or Outer Checkpoint)* | [Combat] | **3 Successes** | **Tactical Bypass ([Infiltrate]):** Target $D = 4$ | Alarm sounds! All deployed operatives lose **1 static die**; Stage 2 $D$ increases by **$+1$ Success**. |
| **2** | **Broker's Safe-Vault** *(or Lift Terminal Control)* | [Operations] | **4 Successes** *(5 if S1 failed)* | **Force Breach ([Combat]):** Target $D = 5$ | **Mission Failure:** Lockdown seals target. Add **[+1 DOOM]** to Campaign Track (Retriable). |

---

## 3. Detailed Stage Breakdown

### Stage 1: Syndicate Alleyway / Outer Checkpoint Watchtower
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 3 Successes**
  * *Narrative:* Neutralizing armed syndicate lookouts in the rain-soaked alleyway (or perimeter guards at the mountain fence).
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Tactical Bypass ([Infiltrate]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Infiltrate] at **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**.
  * *Narrative:* The squad slips unseen across neon-lit rooftop fire escapes or frozen drainage pipes.
* **Momentum Threshold ([MOM]):** $5+$ Successes on [Combat] ($6+$ on [Infiltrate]) generates $\text{Momentum} = \text{Total Successes} - D - 1$.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Security alert sounds!
  * Every deployed operative immediately loses **1 static die** from their pool due to shock.
  * Downstream lockdown: Stage 2 Target Difficulty escalates by **`+1 Success`**.

---

### Stage 2: Broker's Safe-Vault / Lift Terminal Control (Climax Stage)
* **Preset Focus:** [Operations] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes** *(Escalates to **5 Successes** if Stage 1 failed)*
  * *Narrative:* Cracking the biometric encryption lock on the broker's safe-vault (or hacking the blast doors to hijack the subterranean lift).
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Force Breach ([Combat]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Combat] at **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes** *(or **6 Successes** if Stage 1 failed)*.
  * *Narrative:* Blow the reinforced vault door with thermal charges and fight through the converging security response team.
* **Stage Clearance:**
  * **Mission Accomplished!** Award **[6 CR]** and **[1 PIP]** (distributed per Campaign / Squad Leader rules) and advance the campaign dossier to **Mission 2**.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Mission Failure):**
  * Internal lockdown seals the vault/lift completely, forcing an emergency extraction empty-handed.
  * Advance the Campaign Doom Track by **[+1 DOOM]**. If [DOOM] is below 3, the squad returns to HQ for Downtime and may retry Mission 1.

# Mission 2: Deep-Sea Laboratory Raid / The Subterranean Core

> **Campaign:** [Operation: Iron Dawn](../campaigns/campaign-iron-dawn.md) (`Mission 2 of 3`)  
> **Location:** Pacific Trench Facility ([Facility] Ocean Platform) / Subterranean Bio-Core ([Facility] Variant)  
> **Base Clearance Bounty:** [8 CR], [2 PIP]  
> **Squad Target Requirement:** $\ge 1$ [Combat], $\ge 1$ [Intel] operative

---

## 1. Narrative Briefing & Theater Variants

* **Revised Global Macro-Arc ("Deep-Sea Laboratory Raid" — Pacific Trench Rig):** Using the encryption keys recovered in Mission 1, HQ tracks Ascendant Bio-Tech's primary genetic laboratory to a submerged ocean platform in the Pacific Trench. The squad deploys via stealth sub-pod to clear the docking bay, destroy the automated Enforcer mech guarding the inner bulkhead, and siphon prototype genetic blueprints from the sub-level mainframe.
* **Facility Incursion Variant ("The Subterranean Core"):** Descending into the lower containment sectors of Ascendant's facility, the squad breaches security patrols, defeats the heavy mech bottleneck, and extracts classified telemetry before automated purges wipe the servers.
* **Return to HQ:** Upon clearing Stage 3, the squad extracts with the blueprints and orbital coordinates, returning to HQ to prepare for the final strike against Ascendant's high-orbit command array.
* **Retry Narrative:** If Stage 3 fails, automated server purges wipe the local terminal and force the squad to retreat to the sub-pod ([+1 DOOM]). Retrying launches a second dive against an alerted facility before the backup drives are relocated.

---

## 2. Preset Stage Track (3 Stages)

| Stage | Stage Name | Preset Focus | Target Difficulty ($D$) | Dynamic Focus Swap Option | Stage Failure Penalty |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Ocean Platform Docks** *(or Containment Patrol)* | [Combat] | **4 Successes** | **Tactical Bypass ([Survival]):** Cost [1 EF], Target $D = 4$ | Ambush counter-attack! Every deployed operative takes **1 HP damage**. |
| **2** | **Heavy Enforcer Gate** | [Combat] | **3 Successes** | *(None — Mandatory Kinetic Bottleneck)* | Heavy fire! Squad Leader loses **[2 CR]**; Stage 3 $D$ increases by **$+1$ Success**. |
| **3** | **Sub-Level Mainframe** *(or Bio-Lab Mainframe)* | [Intel] | **4 Successes** *(5 if S2 failed)* | **Force Breach ([Combat]):** Target $D = 6$ | **Mission Failure:** Data wiped! Squad retreats empty-handed. Add **[+1 DOOM]**. |

---

## 3. Detailed Stage Breakdown

### Stage 1: Ocean Platform Docks / Containment Sector Patrol
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**
  * *Narrative:* Ambushing a heavily armed Ascendant security squad patrolling the sub-pod docking bay and bio-chambers.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Tactical Bypass ([Survival]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may spend **[1 EF]** from their Faction Vault to shift the stage to [Survival] at **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**.
  * *Narrative:* Bypass the patrol by navigating pressurized seawater intake ducts and active toxic ventilation shafts.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Ambush counter-attack! Every deployed operative takes **1 point of HP damage** (mitigable by Armor Buffers).

---

### Stage 2: Heavy Enforcer Gate (Mandatory Fight)
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 3 Successes**
  * *Narrative:* Point-blank clash against an automated heavy security mech blocking the reinforced vault bulkhead.
* **No Dynamic Swap Available:** This stage is a mandatory kinetic bottleneck and cannot be bypassed.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Heavy suppressive fire damages squad equipment! The Squad Leader immediately loses **[2 CR]** from their Faction Vault.
  * Additionally, Stage 3 Target Difficulty escalates by **`+1 Success`**.

---

### Stage 3: Sub-Level Mainframe / Bio-Lab Mainframe (Climax Stage)
* **Preset Focus:** [Intel] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes** *(Escalates to **5 Successes** if Stage 2 failed)*
  * *Narrative:* Siphoning core genetic telemetry and orbital command coordinates while automated containment purges initiate.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Force Breach ([Combat]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Combat] at **Target Difficulty: 6 Successes** *(or **7 Successes** if Stage 2 failed)*.
  * *Narrative:* Destroy the server liquid-cooling housing with gunfire to force an emergency physical core dump while holding off automated defense turrets.
* **Stage Clearance:**
  * **Mission Accomplished!** Award **[8 CR]** and **[2 PIP]** and advance the campaign dossier to **Mission 3**.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Mission Failure):**
  * The anti-intrusion wipe completes and the squad is forced to retreat empty-handed.
  * Advance the Campaign Doom Track by **[+1 DOOM]**. If [DOOM] remains below 3, the squad returns to HQ and may retry Mission 2.

# Mission 3: Orbital Array Sabotage / Extraction Zero

> **Campaign:** [Operation: Iron Dawn](../campaigns/campaign-iron-dawn.md) (`Mission 3 of 3 — Campaign Finale`)  
> **Location:** High-Orbit Communications Spire ([Space] Macro-Arc) / Meltdown Landing Strip ([Facility] Variant)  
> **Base Clearance Bounty:** **CAMPAIGN VICTORY!** (Triggers Final Executive [VP] Audit)  
> **Squad Target Requirement:** $\ge 2$ [Combat], $\ge 1$ [Survival] operative

---

## 1. Narrative Briefing & Theater Variants

* **Revised Global Macro-Arc ("Orbital Array Sabotage" — High-Orbit Spire):** To permanently dismantle Ascendant Bio-Tech, the squad launches an orbital assault shuttle to breach their high-orbit broadcast station, sabotage the primary power relays, and sever their global command network at the Master Control Hub.
* **Facility Incursion Variant ("Extraction Zero"):** With telemetry secured, the facility enters catastrophic meltdown. The squad must overload the reactor terminal, hold the rooftop helipad against waves of reinforcements, and dash across the collapsing superstructure onto the extraction shuttle.
* **Retry Narrative:** If Stage 3 fails, the sabotage sequence is aborted (or the shuttle is forced to wave off) and the squad executes an emergency retreat ([+1 DOOM]). If [DOOM] reaches `3`, the Agency suffers **Game Over**; if [DOOM] is `1` or `2`, the squad returns to HQ and may launch a second orbital drop before the station changes orbit.

---

## 2. Preset Stage Track (3 Stages — Campaign Climax)

| Stage | Stage Name | Preset Focus | Target Difficulty ($D$) | Dynamic Focus Swap Option | Stage Failure Penalty |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Hangar Bay Breach** *(or Overload Terminal)* | [Combat] *(or [Operations])* | **4 Successes** | **Bypass ([Infiltrate] D4)** *or* **Breach ([Combat] D5)** | Explosion vents through chamber! Every deployed operative takes **1 HP damage** and loses **1 static die**. |
| **2** | **Relay Power Grid** *(or Helipad Defense)* | [Operations] *(or [Combat])* | **4–5 Successes** | **Force Breach ([Combat] D5)** *(Mandatory Siege in Variant)* | Heavy crossfire! Every deployed operative takes **1 HP damage**; Stage 3 $D$ increases by **$+1$ Success**. |
| **3** | **Master Control Hub** *(or Evacuation Dash)* | [Combat] | **4–5 Successes** *(+1 if S2 failed)* | **Tactical Bypass ([Survival] D4–5):** Cost `1 die/operative` | **Mission Failure:** Add **[+1 DOOM]**. If [DOOM] $< 3$, squad may retry Mission 3. |

---

## 3. Detailed Stage Breakdown

### Stage 1: Hangar Bay Breach / Overload Terminal
* **Global Orbital Track (`Hangar Bay Breach`):**
  * **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes** (*Breaching the orbital docking bay under guard fire*).
  * **Tactical Bypass ([Infiltrate]):** Shift to [Infiltrate] at **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes** (*Slip through external zero-g maintenance airlocks*).
* **Facility Meltdown Track (`Overload Terminal`):**
  * **Preset Focus:** [Operations] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes** (*Overclocking the facility power core to destroy all remaining research*).
  * **Force Breach ([Combat]):** Shift to [Combat] at **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes** (*Shoot out the control relays manually under heavy guard fire*).
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Core malfunction and explosive decompression! **Every deployed operative takes 1 point of HP damage** and loses **1 static die** from their pool.

---

### Stage 2: Relay Power Grid / Helipad Defense
* **Global Orbital Track (`Relay Power Grid`):**
  * **Preset Focus:** [Operations] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes** (*Sabotaging the station's primary broadcast power conduits*).
  * **Force Breach ([Combat]):** Shift to [Combat] at **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes** (*Demolish the relay transformers while holding off orbital security forces*).
* **Facility Meltdown Track (`Helipad Defense`):**
  * **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes** (*Mandatory siege firefight holding off waves of enemy reinforcements on the rooftop helipad; no Dynamic Swap available*).
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Heavy crossfire! **Every deployed operative takes 1 point of HP damage** and Stage 3 Target Difficulty escalates by **`+1 Success`**.

---

### Stage 3: Master Control Hub / Evacuation Dash (Campaign Finale)
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes** on Orbital Track / **4 Successes** on Facility Track *(Escalates by **`+1 Success`** if Stage 2 failed)*
  * *Narrative:* Severing Ascendant's master network core and fighting across the burning landing bay to reach the open extraction shuttle ramp.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Tactical Bypass ([Survival]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), **every deployed operative may spend 1 static die** from their pool to shift the stage to [Survival] at **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes** (Facility Track) or **5 Successes** (Orbital Track).
  * *Narrative:* Leap across collapsing superstructure catwalks and zero-g debris directly onto the extraction shuttle ramp.
* **Stage Clearance (Campaign Victory!):**
  * **CAMPAIGN VICTORY!** Ascendant Bio-Tech's network is permanently destroyed and the strike team escapes into orbit. Proceed immediately to the **Final Executive [VP] Audit**: convert [PIP] (`[2 VP]`), living & Dead Pool [LOY] (`[2 VP]` + `[3 VP]` per Tier 4 Icon), and score Tiered **Secret Objectives** (`15 / 10 / [5 VP]`).
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Mission Failure):**
  * The sabotage charges fail / the shuttle is forced to wave off! Advance the Campaign Doom Track by **[+1 DOOM]**. If [DOOM] reaches `3`, the campaign ends in **Game Over (Agency Collapse)**. If [DOOM] is `1` or `2`, the squad returns to HQ and may retry Mission 3.

body:
# Side-Mission: Recover Enemy Intel

> **Themes:** 🏙️ [Urban] • 💼 [Covert] • 🔬 [Facility]  
> **Base Clearance Bounty:** [6 CR], [1 PIP]  
> **Bonus Stealth Bounty:** Maintain stealth through Stage 1 ([Infiltrate] Swap cleared) $\rightarrow$ **[+3 CR], [+1 PIP]** ([9 CR], [2 PIP] Total!)

---

## 1. Narrative Briefing

A rival corporate directorate is storing unredacted black-project dossiers inside a fortified regional data annex. The strike team deploys between Campaign Missions to neutralize or slip past the outer perimeter watchtower, navigate the internal security blast doors, and siphon the classified drives from the central Data Vault before an anti-intrusion wipe purges the servers.

---

## 2. Preset Stage Track (3 Stages)

| Stage | Stage Name | Preset Focus | Target Difficulty ($D$) | Dynamic Focus Swap Option | Stage Failure Penalty |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Perimeter Watchtower** | [Combat] | **3 Successes** | **Stealth Insertion ([Infiltrate]):** Target $D = 4$ | Alarm Tripped! Stealth bounty lost; all operatives lose **1 static die**; S2 & S3 $D$ **$+1$**. |
| **2** | **Internal Navigation** | [Operations] | **3 Successes** *(4 if loud/failed)* | **Force Breach ([Combat]):** Target $D = 5$ | Venting Gas! All deployed operatives take **1 HP damage** and Squad Leader loses **[1 EF]**. |
| **3** | **The Data Vault** | [Intel] | **3 Successes** *(5 if alert high)* | **Force Breach ([Combat]):** Target $D = 6$ | **Mission Failure (Wipe):** Data lost! Squad extracts empty-handed without base payouts. |

---

## 3. Detailed Stage Breakdown

### Stage 1: Perimeter Watchtower
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 3 Successes**
  * *Narrative:* Assaulting the outer perimeter watchtower with suppressed kinetic fire (note: clearing via loud [Combat] forfeits the Bonus Stealth Bounty and raises internal alert to $D=4$ on Stage 2).
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Stealth Insertion ([Infiltrate]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Infiltrate] at **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**.
  * *Narrative:* Ghost past the watchtower searchlights undetected, preserving the **Bonus Stealth Bounty (`[+3 CR], [+1 PIP]`)** and keeping Stage 2 and Stage 3 at their minimum Target Difficulty (`3 Successes`).
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Alarm Tripped! The Bonus Stealth Bounty is failed.
  * Every deployed operative loses **1 static die** from shock.
  * Security blast doors lock downstream: Stage 2 and Stage 3 Target Difficulties escalate by **`+1 Success`**.

---

### Stage 2: Internal Navigation
* **Preset Focus:** [Operations] — **Target Difficulty: 3 Successes** if Stage 1 stealth succeeded; **4 Successes** if Stage 1 was loud or failed.
  * *Narrative:* Hacking internal blast door controls and bypassing laser grids to reach the central data core.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Force Breach ([Combat]):**
  * Shift the stage to [Combat] at **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes** (*Blow the internal blast doors and fight through facility security*).
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Security countermeasures trigger! Venting neuro-gas inflicts **1 point of HP damage** on every deployed operative and deducts **[1 EF]** from the Squad Leader's Faction Vault.

---

### Stage 3: The Data Vault (Climax Stage)
* **Preset Focus:** [Intel] — **Target Difficulty: 3 Successes** if stealth was maintained; **5 Successes** if facility alert is high.
  * *Narrative:* Siphoning classified solid-state drives under high-pressure encryption countermeasures.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Force Breach ([Combat]):**
  * Shift the stage to [Combat] at **Target Difficulty: 6 Successes** (*Physically rip out the server blades under automated turret fire*).
* **Stage Clearance:**
  * **Side-Mission Cleared!** Award **[6 CR]** and **[1 PIP]** (plus **[+3 CR]** and **[+1 PIP]** if stealth was maintained in Stage 1).
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Mission Failure):**
  * Anti-intrusion wipe completes! The data is permanently lost. The squad returns to HQ empty-handed without base payouts (adds [0 DOOM] unless specified otherwise by the active Campaign Dossier).

# Side-Mission: Black-Market Arms Cache

> **Themes:** 🏙️ [Urban] • 💼 [Covert]  
> **Base Clearance Bounty:** [7 CR], [1 PIP]  
> **Bonus Bounty:** Clear Stage 3 with **Momentum ([MOM], $+2$ or higher above $D$)** $\rightarrow$ **`+1 Free Consumable Item Card`**

## 1. Narrative Briefing

# Side-Mission: Derelict Satellite Salvage

> **Themes:** 🛰️ [Space]  
> **Base Clearance Bounty:** [6 CR], [2 PIP]  
> **Bonus Bounty:** Spend **[0 EF]** during the entire mission $\rightarrow$ **[+2 CR]** ([8 CR], [2 PIP] Total!)

---

## 1. Narrative Briefing

A decommissioned corporate research satellite is drifting into terminal orbital decay. The strike team docks via assault shuttle to navigate the zero-g hull debris field, neutralize or hack the active sentry drone bay, and siphon prototype telemetry cores before atmospheric re-entry incinerates the station.

---

## 2. Preset Stage Track (3 Stages)

| **2** | **Sentry Drone Bay** | [Combat] | **4 Successes** | **Tactical Bypass ([Operations]):** Target $D = 4$ | Electrical discharge! Squad Leader loses **[1 EF]** from their Faction Vault. |
| **3** | **Mainframe Core Siphon** | [Intel] | **4 Successes** | **Force Breach ([Combat]):** Target $D = 6$ | **Mission Failure:** Orbit decays! Squad retreats empty-handed without base payouts. |

---

## 3. Detailed Stage Breakdown

### Stage 1: Airlock Debris Field
* **Preset Focus:** [Survival] — **Target Difficulty: 3 Successes**

* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Force Breach ([Combat]):**

  * *Narrative:* Hack the drone sub-terminal to shut them down remotely.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**

* **Stage Failure Penalty (Mission Failure):**
  * Orbit decays! The mission fails and the squad retreats to the shuttle empty-handed without base payouts.

# Side-Mission: Sub-Grid Power Siphon

> **Themes:** 🔬 [Facility] • 🏙️ [Urban]  
> **Base Clearance Bounty:** [5 CR], **[2 EF]** *(deposited directly into Faction Vault)*  
> **Bonus Bounty:** Clear Stage 2 without rolling any **natural 1s (Backfires)** $\rightarrow$ **[+2 CR]** ([7 CR], [2 EF] Total!)

---

## 1. Narrative Briefing

Located in the subterranean levels of a massive corporate arcology, an auxiliary power substation feeds high-density energy to regional security grids. The strike team infiltrates the sub-grid to neutralize perimeter sentries, recalibrate the high-voltage conduits, and siphon raw [EF] battery reserves directly into Faction Vaults.

---

## 2. Preset Stage Track (3 Stages)

| **3** | **Generator Overdrive** | [Survival] | **4 Successes** | **Tactical Bypass ([Operations]):** Target $D = 4$ | **Mission Failure:** Generator safety trip! Squad extracts without payouts. |

---

### Stage 1: Maintenance Checkpoint
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 3 Successes**

# Side-Mission: Bio-Specimen Containment Purge

> **Themes:** 🌲 [Planet] • 🔬 [Facility]  
> **Base Clearance Bounty:** [6 CR], [1 PIP]  
> **Bonus Bounty:** Deploy at least **1 `Scientist` operative** on the squad $\rightarrow$ **`+1 Free Consumable Item Card`**

---

## 1. Narrative Briefing

A surface bio-research laboratory on an isolated jungle planet has suffered a catastrophic alien specimen containment breach. The strike team touches down to override the sealed decontamination airlocks, purge the swarming bio-specimens nesting in the main atrium, and siphon the genetic sequencing data before the facility's automated thermal purge incinerates the lab.

---

## 2. Preset Stage Track (3 Stages)

| Stage | Stage Name | Preset Focus | Target Difficulty ($D$) | Dynamic Focus Swap Option | Stage Failure Penalty |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Decontamination Chamber Seal** | [Operations] | **3 Successes** | **Force Breach ([Combat]):** Target $D = 4$ | Toxic gas leak! Every deployed operative takes **1 HP damage**. |
| **2** | **Specimen Nest Siege** | [Combat] | **5 Successes** | *(None — Mandatory Siege Firefight)* | Vicious onslaught! Every deployed operative takes **1 HP damage** and loses **1 static die**. |
| **3** | **Genetic Data Core** | [Intel] | **4 Successes** | **Tactical Bypass ([Survival]):** Target $D = 4$ | **Mission Failure:** Lab purges automatically! Data destroyed; squad extracts without payouts. |

---

## 3. Detailed Stage Breakdown

### Stage 1: Decontamination Chamber Seal
* **Preset Focus:** [Operations] — **Target Difficulty: 3 Successes**
  * *Narrative:* Overriding sealed bio-hazard airlock doors to access the quarantined laboratory interior.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Force Breach ([Combat]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Combat] at **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**.
  * *Narrative:* Blast through the reinforced quartz decontamination glass with explosive charges.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Toxic gas leak! Every deployed operative takes **1 point of HP damage**.

---

### Stage 2: Specimen Nest Siege (Mandatory Fight)
* **Preset Focus:** [Combat] — **Target Difficulty: 5 Successes**
  * *Narrative:* Holding the defensive perimeter against swarming bio-specimens inside the overgrown main atrium.
* **No Dynamic Swap Available:** Mandatory siege firefight.
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Tactical Blowback):**
  * Vicious onslaught! Every deployed operative takes **1 point of HP damage** and loses **1 static die** from their pool.

---

### Stage 3: Genetic Data Core (Climax Stage)
* **Preset Focus:** [Intel] — **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**
  * *Narrative:* Siphoning genetic sequencing data from the central laboratory core while the self-destruct countdown ticks down.
* **Dynamic Focus Swap — Tactical Bypass ([Survival]):**
  * During Step 1 (Briefing), the Squad Leader may shift the stage to [Survival] at **Target Difficulty: 4 Successes**.
  * *Narrative:* Grab the physical specimen cryo-canisters and escape through flooded jungle drainage pipes.
* **Stage Clearance:**
  * **Side-Mission Cleared!** Award **[6 CR]** and **[1 PIP]** (plus **`+1 free Consumable Item card`** if at least 1 `Scientist` operative was deployed on the 4-character away team).
* **Stage Failure Penalty (Mission Failure):**
  * The lab purges automatically! The genetic data is incinerated and the mission fails without base payouts.
